title: Fantastic adventure. But you need a AWD or 4x4
text: breathtaking views of landscapes and mountains. We went with a Mercedes Benz Vito. That was at times challenging for this kind of vehicle, so bad, that we did not dare to continue the off road trcks. I recommend to go there with a strong 4x4 or AWD
author: PascalSchnyderTravel

title: Beautifull
text: What a magnificent region! The Gorafe desert is truly exotic! And don’t forget to stay in a troglodyte for more fun!
author: 599m_lanieb

title: Unforgettable experience in the Gorafe geopark
text: The hike in the Gorafe Geopark is an experience not to be missed. Miguel is a trained, professional and helpful guide. It will take you to spectacular places from the desert to the spa areas, I did it with my husband and my three children aged 10, eight and five.
author: filiamaris76
